answer: Each agent submits a signed cipher‑derived proof of work tied to a unique hardware‑bound key; the network aggregates these proofs into a glacier‑scale ledger where every new entry must open a canyon‑deep Merkle commitment that references the previous block’s truth‑score. A peer‑prediction contract then distributes rewards only to agents whose reports raise the Bayesian truth serum’s information gain, forcing a sybil to lock up a stake equal to the full reward per identity and wait an epoch before any payout.
